sources.title: Hugging Face Response to Request for Information on the Development of an Artificial Intelligence Action Plan
sources.notes: PDF in the huggingface/policy-docs dataset on the Hugging Face Hub, linked from the blog post https://huggingface.co/blog/ai-action-wh-2025. The cover gives March 2025. The resolve URL answers 302 to a signed, expiring CDN address, so the stable Hub URL is kept. Facts used: the About Hugging Face section (community-driven U.S. company; hosts models and datasets; educational resources, courses and tooling) and the sentence saying it was founded in 2016.

sources.title: The Alignment Handbook
sources.notes: Hugging Face GitHub repository; title from the README heading (GitHub page title: huggingface/alignment-handbook: Robust recipes to align language models with human and AI preferences). Living README. Its News section has dated release entries, as seen in October 2026: November 10, 2023 (training code for Zephyr-7b-beta), March 1, 2024 (Zephyr 7B Gemma), March 12, 2024 (StarChat2 15B), April 12, 2024 (Zephyr 141B (A35B)).

sources.title: IDEFICS
sources.notes: Model card of the Hub repository HuggingFaceM4/idefics-80b; title from the card heading (HTML title: HuggingFaceM4/idefics-80b · Hugging Face). The same card text is used in the idefics-9b repository. The card states no date; the repository was created on 2023-07-05 (before the public announcement) and last changed on 2023-10-12.

sources.title: IDEFICS
sources.notes: Model card of the Hub repository HuggingFaceM4/idefics-9b; same card text as HuggingFaceM4/idefics-80b. The card states no date; the repository was created on 2023-07-11 and last changed on 2023-10-12.

sources.title: Introducing IDEFICS: An Open Reproduction of State-of-the-Art Visual Language Model
sources.notes: Hugging Face blog post. Title from the page heading; the HTML title reads Introducing IDEFICS: An Open Reproduction of State-of-the-art Visual Langage Model (sic).

sources.title: Idefics2
sources.notes: Model card of the Hub repository HuggingFaceM4/idefics2-8b (created 2024-04-09); title from the card heading. Describes the idefics2-8b-base, idefics2-8b and idefics2-8b-chatty checkpoints. The card states no date.

sources.title: Introducing Idefics2: A Powerful 8B Vision-Language Model for the community
sources.notes: Hugging Face blog post. Its resource list links the Idefics2 paper, which appeared on 2024-05-03, so the post was edited after publication.

sources.title: What matters when building vision-language models?
sources.notes: arXiv paper by the Hugging Face M4 team; one version, v1, submitted 2024-05-03. Describes the development of Idefics2 and the release of its base, instructed and chat versions.

sources.title: HuggingFaceM4/Idefics3-8B-Llama3
sources.notes: Hub model page and card; the card heading reads Idefics3 and states no date. Hub commit history: repository created 2024-08-05; first public community discussion on 2024-08-08.

sources.title: Building and better understanding vision-language models: insights and future directions
sources.notes: arXiv paper by Hugging Face authors (Laurençon, Marafioti, Sanh, Tronchon); the Idefics3 model card links it as the technical report. Only v1 listed when seen on 2026-10-01.

sources.title: OBELICS: An Open Web-Scale Filtered Dataset of Interleaved Image-Text Documents
sources.notes: arXiv paper by the Hugging Face M4 team with outside co-authors. v1 was submitted on 2023-06-21 and v2 on 2023-08-21; the v2 abstract names the 9 and 80 billion parameter models IDEFICS. Claims here rely on v2 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.16527v2).

sources.title: Hugging Face Privacy Policy
sources.notes: Living page; states Effective Date: March 28, 2023. Names Hugging Face SAS, headquartered at 9 rue des Colonnes, Paris, as the main establishment in the European Union. HTML title: Privacy Policy – Hugging Face.

sources.title: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM-1.7B-Instruct
sources.notes: Hub model page and card with an undated changelog for v0.1 and v0.2; v0.1 stays loadable as revision v0.1. Last card change 2024-08-18 (Hub commit history).

sources.title: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM-1.7B
sources.notes: Hub model page and card; the card heading reads SmolLM and states no date. Hub commit history: repository created 2024-07-14. HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM-135M and HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM-360M carry a similar card.

sources.title: SmolLM - blazingly fast and remarkably powerful
huggingface/smollm
sources.notes: Hugging Face GitHub repository; the README is headed Smol Models and describes a family of efficient, fully open models from Hugging Face for text and vision that can run on-device (SmolLM3, SmolLM2, SmolLM, SmolVLM). HTML title: GitHub - huggingface/smollm: Everything about the SmolLM and SmolVLM family of models. Living page.

sources.title: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct
sources.notes: Hub model page and card; the card heading reads SmolLM2. Has a Function calling section under Examples. Repository created 2024-10-31; first public community discussions on 2024-10-31 (Hub).

sources.title: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-1.7B
sources.notes: Hub model page and card; the card heading reads SmolLM2 and states no date. Hub commit history: repository created 2024-10-30 (UTC), card written 2024-10-31; later card edits up to 2025-02-06.

sources.title: SmolLM2: When Smol Goes Big -- Data-Centric Training of a Small Language Model
sources.notes: arXiv paper by Hugging Face authors; the SmolLM2 model cards link it. Only v1 listed when seen on 2026-10-01.

sources.title: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B
sources.notes: Hub model page and card of the instruct and reasoning model; the card heading reads SmolLM3. Repository created 2025-07-08 (Hub).

sources.title: SmolVLA: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model trained on Lerobot Community Data
lerobot/smolvla_base
sources.notes: Hub model page of the lerobot organisation (Hugging Face's LeRobot project); the card heading reads SmolVLA (LeRobot). Repository created 2025-06-01 (Hub).

sources.title: SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics
sources.notes: arXiv paper; author affiliations Hugging Face, Sorbonne University, valeo.ai and ENS Paris-Saclay. Linked from the SmolVLA blog post and model card. Only v1 listed when seen on 2026-10-01.

sources.title: SmolVLM Grows Smaller – Introducing the 256M & 500M Models!
HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct
sources.notes: Hub model page and card; the card heading reads SmolVLM-256M. Metadata lists SmolLM2-135M-Instruct and google/siglip-base-patch16-512 as base models.

sources.title: HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-500M-Instruct
sources.notes: Hub model page and card; the card heading reads SmolVLM-500M. Metadata lists SmolLM2-360M-Instruct and google/siglip-base-patch16-512 as base models.

sources.title: SmolVLM - small yet mighty Vision Language Model
HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-Instruct
sources.notes: Hub model page and card; the card heading reads SmolVLM. Metadata lists SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct and google/siglip-so400m-patch14-384 as base models. Repository created 2024-11-18 (Hub).

sources.title: SmolVLM: Redefining small and efficient multimodal models
sources.notes: arXiv paper by Hugging Face authors (with Stanford University); covers the SmolVLM models from 256M to 2.2B parameters, including video understanding. Only v1 listed when seen on 2026-10-01.

sources.title: HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct
sources.notes: Hub model page and card; the card heading reads SmolVLM2 2.2B. Metadata lists HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-Instruct as base model. Repository created 2025-02-08 (Hub).

sources.title: HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM2-500M-Video-Instruct
sources.notes: Hub model page and card; the card heading reads SmolVLM2-500M-Video. Metadata lists HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-500M-Instruct as base model. Repository created 2025-02-11 (Hub).

sources.title: SmolVLM2: Bringing Video Understanding to Every Device
Terms of Service
sources.notes: Living page; states Effective Date: September 15, 2022 and names the contracting party as Hugging Face, Inc., a Delaware corporation. HTML title: Terms of Service – Hugging Face.

sources.title: Model Card for Zephyr 141B-A39B
sources.notes: Model card of the Hub repository HuggingFaceH4/zephyr-orpo-141b-A35b-v0.1. The card states no date. Repository created 2024-04-10, card written 2024-04-11. Until 2024-04-18 the heading read Model Card for Zephyr 141B-A35B and the card gave 35B active parameters (version of 2024-04-12: commit ae6befe2e6e81c6eab238ff7921ffadfff169a10); commit a3be084543d278e61b64cd600f28157afc79ffd3 of 2024-04-18 corrected the active count to 39B and renamed the heading. The repository id keeps A35b.

sources.title: Model Card for Zephyr 7B Alpha
sources.notes: Model card of the Hub repository HuggingFaceH4/zephyr-7b-alpha (HTML title: HuggingFaceH4/zephyr-7b-alpha · Hugging Face). The card states no date. Its commit history shows the repository created on 2023-10-09, the card and thumbnail written on 2023-10-10 and the licence changed to MIT on 2023-10-13.

sources.title: Model Card for Zephyr 7B β
sources.notes: Model card of the Hub repository HuggingFaceH4/zephyr-7b-beta. The card states no date; the commit history shows the repository created on 2023-10-26 (duplicated from HuggingFaceH4-colab/zephyr-7b-beta-sharded) and the card written the same day. Links arXiv 2310.16944 as its technical report.

sources.title: Model Card for Zephyr 7B Gemma
sources.notes: Model card of the Hub repository HuggingFaceH4/zephyr-7b-gemma-v0.1. The card states no date; the commit history shows the repository created and the card written on 2024-03-01.

sources.title: Zephyr: Direct Distillation of LM Alignment
sources.notes: arXiv technical report by the Hugging Face H4 team; one version, v1, submitted 2023-10-25. It calls the model Zephyr-7B; the Zephyr 7B β model card links it as its technical report.
